thread:
sam: quick check  for the new settings form keep red asterisks or show a visible 'Required' label? accessibility and translation concerns.
leah: visible 'Required' label. clearer for screen readers and translators. asterisk confuses some folks.
dmitri: agree, but make it visually subtle. low-contrast gray for the word, but ensure it still meets 3:1 for small text.
qa-bot: contrast check: #7a7a7a meets 3:1 for 14px. five fields flagged at #bdbdbd.
a11y-bot: recommendation: visible 'Required' text after label, not prefixed. ensure aria-required is also present for programmatic checks.
sam: validation cadence: validate on blur or on submit? want to avoid noisy live errors.
leah: blur for most fields, live for confirmation fields (password match). avoid live password policy errors that leak policy gradations.
dmitri: implement top summary on submit listing errors with anchor links to each field. when clicked, focus the field and reveal inline error. avoid abrupt scroll; respect prefers-reduced-motion.
sam: code hint from eng: `firstInvalid.focus({preventScroll: true}); if (!prefersReducedMotion) firstInvalid.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'center'});`
leah: destructive action: delete workspace. typed-confirm vs undo toast?
dmitri: typed-confirm for workspace (require name), undo toast for smaller deletes. also add soft-delete retention (7 days) and audit log.
a11y-bot: modal checklist: role="dialog", aria-modal="true", trap focus, and announce danger level. typed input should get focus on open and be labelled.
sam: can design produce compact + full spec with tokens, copy, and a11y notes so eng can implement both?
leah: yes, i'll upload both variants and a prototype. thanks! :white_check_mark:
